messages:
maria_r: quick sync - following up on continuous-batching tradeoffs. want to finalize admission shim v1 behavior before i ship a prototype.
akash_k: short checklist?
maria_r: minimal surface: classification -> queue_tag, return opaque slot_token, estimate expected_wait_ms_est. no forced routing in v1, only telemetry + a very small probabilistic canary.
linh_t: workers ignore slot_token by default, right?
maria_r: yes. only canary-enabled workers will call KV.Pin(slot_token). missing token -> mark exec_cold.
sam_sre: ops asks for explicit metrics: admission_enqueues_total{queue_tag,model,tenant}, admission_rejects_total{reason}, worker_execs_total{exec_cold}, warmup_attempts_total, warmup_dropped_total, queue_circuit_tripped_total.
julia_pm: product note: we need clear defaults so app teams don't accidentally request warmups and blow cost. docs must stress conservative defaults.
akash_k: routing knobs: base_prob and surge_prob (surge active when queue growth rate > X). add smoothing to avoid thrash.
linh_t: warmup dedupe: short in-memory cache keyed by (model,queue_tag,slot_prefix) with ~200ms window. cap warmup concurrency per-GPU.
maria_r: rollout plan: FF telemetry-only 72h -> 1% canary routing in staging + simulator -> slot_token warmups for canaries -> circuit-breaker + fastpath ramp. each step needs dashboards and rollback doc.
sam_sre: rollback playbook: flip ff/queue-admit-v1 off per-region -> legacy shaper. verify queues drain <5m; if not escalate and kill new worker processes. add runbook entry.
akash_k: prototyping note: implement shim in Rust, expose shared-memory for per-worker clients (fast path <500ns), fallback to RPC if missing. microbenchmarks required.
julia_pm: include cost vs latency numbers in rollout docs so stakeholders can approve ramp.
maria_r: API sketch for docs:
POST /v1/admit
body: { model: string, token_count: int, urgency?: "interactive"|"normal"|"low", cache_hint?: "warm"|"none", policy_id?: string }
resp: { enqueued: true|false, slot_token?: string, queue_tag: string, expected_wait_ms_est: int }
linh_t: rename latency_hint -> urgency in docs to avoid UX collisions.
sam_sre: tracing: add span "admission.enqueue" and carry traceparent into slot_token to correlate traces.
maria_r: failure modes: lost slot_token -> treat as cold-exec and increment slot_token_loss_total; target <0.1%. also document warmup-stampede mitigations and throttles.
akash_k: will attach early bench numbers to the RFC follow-up. aim to keep shim CPU overhead negligible.
maria_r: action items: i'll draft RFC follow-up with telemetry table, rollout steps, and ops checklist. akash will build shim prototype + harness. sam will write dashboards/alerts. julia will own stakeholder comms. ops-bot: feature flag ff/queue-admit-v1 created in staging.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: ff/queue-admit-v1 created in staging.
maria_r: thanks all, please review the draft when i post it. :thumbsup:
